"This is a stacked bar chart detailing the composition of banking assets over time.

### **Chart Overview**
*   **Title:** Assets by Type
*   **Unit of Measurement:** Percent of total assets
*   **Y-Axis:** Percentage scale from 0 to 150 (though all bars represent a total of 100%).
*   **X-Axis:** Timeline from December 2019 to February 2024.
*   **Data Categories (Legend):**
    *   **Claims on the BCRA:** Dark Blue
    *   **Government securities:** Medium Blue
    *   **Private sector credit:** Light Blue
    *   **Others:** Light Grey

### **Data Extraction (Estimated Percentages)**
The following table provides estimated values for each asset category based on the visual proportions in the chart (each bar sums to 100%).

| Date | Claims on the BCRA (%) | Government securities (%) | Private sector credit (%) | Others (%) | Total (%) |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **Dec-19** | 41 | 10 | 43 | 6 | 100 |
| **Dec-20** | 41 | 12 | 37 | 10 | 100 |
| **Dec-21** | 41 | 15 | 34 | 10 | 100 |
| **Dec-22** | 44 | 15 | 30 | 11 | 100 |
| **Mar-23** | 44 | 14 | 30 | 12 | 100 |
| **Jun-23** | 38 | 13 | 31 | 18 | 100 |
| **Sep-23** | 31 | 13 | 30 | 26 | 100 |
| **Oct-23** | 31 | 13 | 31 | 25 | 100 |
| **Nov-23** | 33 | 14 | 33 | 20 | 100 |
| **Dec-23** | 30 | 17 | 28 | 25 | 100 |
| **Jan-24** | 28 | 17 | 26 | 29 | 100 |
| **Feb-24** | 26 | 24 | 26 | 24 | 100 |

### **Key Observations**
*   **Claims on the BCRA:** Remained the largest single component for most of the period but showed a significant decline starting in mid-2023, dropping from roughly 44% in March 2023 to approximately 26% by February 2024.
*   **Private sector credit:** This category has seen a steady overall decline from its peak of roughly 43% in December 2019 down to 26% in early 2024.
*   **Government securities:** Remained relatively stable between 10-15% for much of the period, before increasing significantly to approximately 24% by February 2024.
*   **Others:** This category grew substantially over the timeline, starting at roughly 6% in December 2019 and peaking near 29% in January 2024."
